title: Tick Tock Clock
blurb: Two seconds of pure deadline pressure, alternating high and low the way a real escapement does. Quiz shows play this while a contestant visibly sweats, and editors reach for it whenever a decision is taking longer than the moment can bear. Loop it under any hesitation and the hesitation gets roughly ten times funnier, because the clock implies a consequence that may not exist at all. Sharp synthesised clicks, no room tone, no background hiss, free to download. The pressure is entirely manufactured and works anyway.
origin: Original synthesis of a mechanical clock's alternating tick and tock.
